name: Netorare Loop ~Kyou Shiranai Otoko ni Mata o Hiraku Tsuma~
original_name: 寝取られループ ～今日知らない男に股を開く妻～
source:
Yuki Miyoshi is just an ordinary office worker.
He lived with his girlfriend Chihiro Komanoma and lived a happy life.

One day, Yuki gets into a traffic accident and runs over his best friend, Takeya, with his car.
Fortunately, it wasn't anything serious, and they settled the matter by having Chihiro take care of him.
However, Takeya woos Chihiro and asks her out on a date while she is caring for him.

Yuki, who happened to witness the date, was knocked unconscious by a car during his state of shock.

When he woke up, he was in his home 6 months in the past.
To stop Chihiro's infidelity, Yuki relives those 6 months.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021090/]Steam[/url]]

Be warned that the artist of this work [url=https://vndb.org/t18414]plagiarized[/url] the chara-design of [url=/s4581]Bubuzuke[/url].
translation:
三好优希只是一名普通上班族。
他与女友小間千寻同居，过着幸福的生活。

某天，优希遭遇交通事故，开车撞到了好友武也。
所幸事故并不严重，两人决定由千寻照顾武也来解决这件事。
然而，武也在千寻照顾自己的期间向她献殷勤，还邀请她约会。

碰巧目睹这场约会的优希，在震惊之中被一辆汽车撞得失去了意识。

醒来后，他发现自己回到了六个月前的家中。
为了阻止千寻出轨，优希重新经历这六个月。

（来源：[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3021090/]Steam[/url]）

请注意，本作画师[url=https://vndb.org/t18414]抄袭[/url]了[url=/s4581]Bubuzuke[/url]的角色设计。
